# Signature Scheme

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SignatureScheme`](gmeow-SignatureScheme.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SignatureScheme>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)

The cryptographic signature scheme used — a value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Distinct from [`gmeow:KeyScheme`](gmeow-KeyScheme.md): a key scheme names the key format (OpenPGP, X.509), while a signature scheme names the algorithm (RSA-SHA256, Ed25519).

Use [`gmeow:SignatureScheme`](gmeow-SignatureScheme.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
